Tool.name: Core Hardware Utility (UEFI)
Tool.description: Core Hardware Utility UEFI pre-boot diagnostic application.
Tool.licenseNote: Built in-house from the Core Hardware Utility project; stage CoreDiag.efi into Toolkit\Tools\Boot\CoreHardwareUtility\.

Tool.name: Windows Memory Diagnostic (Microsoft memtest.efi)
Tool.description: Microsoft Windows Memory Diagnostic EFI loader for UEFI BCD boot.
Tool.licenseNote: Microsoft Windows component; run Toolkit\Tools\Ensure-BootArtifacts.ps1 or copy %Windir%\Boot\EFI\memtest.efi

Tool.name: Firefox (Web Browser)
Tool.description: Mozilla Firefox ESR web browser for research, downloads, and recovery. Runs portably from the USB with its profile stored on the stick. In WinPE, requires a wired (Ethernet) connection; Wi-Fi is not available in WinPE.
Tool.licenseNote: Mozilla Firefox ESR 140.x, licensed under MPL 2.0 and freely redistributable. Deployed portable: self-update disabled via distribution\policies.json and profile kept on the USB (Tools\Firefox\Data\Profile).

Tool.name: Enable Offline Administrator
Tool.description: Enables the built-in local Administrator account on an offline Windows install (enable-only). Requires WinPE with offline OS loaded (startup option 2). Does not set passwords offline — sign in after reboot and set password in Windows. Does not reset Microsoft account, PIN, or Entra ID passwords.
Tool.licenseNote: Built-in CDE recovery workflow; modifies offline SAM hive only.

Tool.name: Disable Offline Administrator
Tool.description: Disables the built-in local Administrator account on an offline Windows install (disable-only). Requires WinPE with offline OS loaded (startup option 2). Sets ACB_DISABLED in offline SAM; does not change passwords. Does not affect Microsoft account, PIN, or Entra ID sign-in.
Tool.licenseNote: Built-in CDE recovery workflow; modifies offline SAM hive only.
